name: László Kovács
bio:
László's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He initially trained as a panel beater, but a chance encounter with a struggling race team seeking someone to restore their damaged bodywork led him down a new path. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to match any color, no matter how faded or obscure, quickly made him indispensable. He prides himself on the quality of his work, seeing each car as a canvas for precision and perfection. László's steady hand and unwavering focus ensure that every vehicle leaving his shop is not only aesthetically pleasing but also protected against the rigors of the track. 

Over the years, László has honed his skills, mastering techniques from classic hand-painted finishes to cutting-edge ceramic coatings. He's known for his calm demeanor, even when faced with tight deadlines and complex requests. Colleagues often seek his advice, appreciating his practical knowledge and willingness to share his expertise. László’s distinctive talent is his ability to anticipate potential problem areas, ensuring the longevity and vibrant appearance of every paint job.

physical.description: A stocky man with kind eyes and hands that show the years of dedicated work.

quirks: Always wears a perfectly clean white coat, even when working with the messiest paints.
Has a lucky paint brush that he's used on every winning car he's worked on.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
